description.value: AT Cafe is a brunch-focused neighborhood cafe on Granville Street in Vancouver, blending Asian-inspired dishes with classic Western breakfast fare. The menu spans Smoked Salmon Avocado Benedicts, Croffles, Onigiri, poke bowls, and specialty lattes including Strawberry Matcha and Ube. Reviews highlight a bright, cozy atmosphere, fresh ingredients, and exceptionally friendly service.
